name: seal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import os,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/expanded-corpus-r530/'
excl={'MANIFEST.json','seal_manifest.output.txt','seal_manifest.receipt.json','guard.lock','search-charge.lock'}
files={}
for d,ds,fs in os.walk(L):
    ds[:]=[x for x in ds if x!='__pycache__']
    for f in fs:
        p=os.path.join(d,f); rel=os.path.relpath(p,L)
        if rel in excl: continue
        files[rel]=hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
need=['ACTUALBRIEF.md','PROPOSALS.md','NETWORK-STOP.md','literal-bindings.json','history-access-inventory.json','access-inventory.json','guard-ledger.jsonl','search-charges.jsonl','search-budget.json','frozen-before.json']
print('missing',[n for n in need if n not in files])
print('frozen-after present', [k for k in files if 'frozen-after' in k])
m=dict(lane='expanded-corpus-r530',file_count=len(files),self_exclusions={'MANIFEST.json':'this manifest cannot hash itself','seal_manifest.output.txt':'output of the sealing run, produced after hashing','seal_manifest.receipt.json':'receipt of the sealing run, produced after hashing','guard.lock':'empty lock file if present','search-charge.lock':'empty lock file if present'},sha256=files)
t=json.dumps(m,indent=1,sort_keys=True)+'\n'
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'write_lane.py','MANIFEST.json'],input=t,text=True,capture_output=True)
print('write',r.returncode,r.stderr[:200],'files',len(files),'manifest sha',hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest())
